summary: Restore a minimal Termux environment at the managed RDC shell boundary so filtered child commands can restart ADB reliably.
reason: A live RDC child command proved that the MCP SDK filters TMPDIR/PREFIX before spawning its local Desktop Commander server; raw ADB therefore fell back to an unwritable global temporary path when its server needed restart.

tests.name: remote-desktop-shell
tests.evidence: test-remote-desktop-shell.py passed 1/1 against a filtered environment and bash -l -c.

tests.name: remote-desktop-watchdog
tests.evidence: test-remote-desktop-watchdog.py passed 16/16 including the inherited SHELL wrapper contract.

capabilities.reason: Restores reliable execution for the existing remote_desktop and device.adb capabilities without changing scope, entrypoints or health semantics.

architecture.reason: Uses the existing RDC controller, MCP SDK inherited SHELL boundary and Tier-0 release owner; no user profile change and no new daemon, scheduler, database, router or source of truth.

rollback: Revert the source commit and promote the prior immutable Tier-0 last-known-good release.
limitations: The first parent-only environment candidate was rolled back after live child-process acceptance failed; it did not become LKG.
The wrapper intentionally restores only a minimal secret-free Termux environment rather than sourcing user shell profiles.
No Android payment activity or banking journey is modified.
No live payment is executed by this maintenance change.
